    AI Overview
    Patrick Muldoon, known for his roles as Richard Hart on Melrose Place and Austin Reed on Days of Our Lives, died on Sunday, April 19, 2026, at age 57 following a heart attack. He passed away in his Beverly Hills home. Muldoon was a staple of 1990s television and also starred in films like Starship Troopers. 
    • Career Highlights: In addition to Melrose Place and Days of Our Lives, he appeared in Saved by the Bell and Who's the Boss?.
    • Recent Work: He was an active producer and actor, recently working on the film Dirty Hands.
    • Tributes: Former co-stars, including Alison Sweeney, described him as talented and kind.

    Patrick Muldoon has passed away at 57 after a heart attack at his Beverly Hills home. Patrick carved out that classic TV heartthrob lane first popping up as Jeff on Saved by the Bell, then really breaking through as Austin Reed on Days of Our Lives, where he became a daytime staple. He carried that momentum into primetime drama on Melrose Place as the slick & scheming Richard Hart, before jumping to the big screen in cult sci-fi action like Starship Troopers as Zander Barcalow. Along the way, he showed up across TV movies, thrillers, and guest roles, building a steady career. R.I.P. Patrick.
